title: Disentangling Homophily and Rarity: Explaining Failure in Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.14823v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Are heterophilic nodes in a graph harder to classify because they are heterophilic or because they are rare? Some existing work frames classification of such nodes as a subgroup generalisation problem, where a model performs well on the majority group at the expense of the rare group. Others explain this as a problem of neighbourhood aggregation in graph neural networks (GNNs). We assess these two viewpoints through a detailed evaluation of six GNNs on five datasets of varying homophily, and find that homophilic nodes tend to be easier to classify, even when they are rare---challenging the subgroup framing. However, our findings also nuance existing beliefs about how GNNs misrepresent heterophilic nodes. We demonstrate that the information needed to classify heterophilic nodes correctly is often recoverable by retraining the classification head of a model, or even just the final linear classification layer.

translated_title: 解耦同质性与稀有性：解释图神经网络中的失败原因
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14823v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：图中的异质性节点难以分类，是因为它们具有异质性，还是因为它们较为稀有？现有的一些研究将这类节点的分类问题框架化为子群泛化问题，即模型在多数群体上表现良好，却以牺牲稀有群体为代价。另一些研究则将其解释为图神经网络（GNNs）中邻域聚合的问题。我们通过详细评估六种GNN在五个不同同质性水平的数据集上的表现，对这两种观点进行了检验，并发现同质性节点往往更容易分类，即使它们很稀有——这一发现挑战了子群框架。然而，我们的结果也细化了关于GNN如何误表示异质性节点的现有认识。我们证明，正确分类异质性节点所需的信息通常可以通过重新训练模型的分类头部，甚至仅重新训练最后的线性分类层来恢复。
tldr: 本研究通过实验表明，图神经网络中异质性节点的分类困难并非主要源于其稀有性，而是可以通过调整分类层来部分解决，从而挑战了子群泛化框架。
en_tdlr: This study shows that classification difficulties for heterophilic nodes in GNNs are not primarily due to rarity and can be partially mitigated by retraining the classification head, challenging the subgroup generalization framework.
